title: Safety of the Co-administration of Three Drugs for Trachoma and Lymphatic Filariasis Elimination
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the triple co administration of albendazole, ivermectin and azithromycine is as safe as the current treatment scheme that consists to treat with albendazole plus ivermectin together and a week later to treat with azithromycin in areas co endemic for lymphatic filariasis and trachoma.
